name: @letbuyy/lcis-security
description: LSAS — Security Analytics System. Read-only, deterministic security intelligence: threat + vulnerability intelligence (governance drift), an attack graph (twin paths public→sensitive), secret/token/identity analytics, abuse detection (operations signals), compliance analytics, a security timeline (change tracking), weighted risk scoring, health bands, and advisory-only recommendations. Never mutates; live security signals stay NOT_CONNECTED with their exact source.
